content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The CO-197 denial cannot be cured through retroactive authorization because Silverbridge does not offer it, and peer-to-peer review is unavailable. Resubmitting the claim or adding records without an appeal would not resolve the missing authorization, while billing the patient could exceed the contractual patient share. A formal medical-necessity appeal is the only available payer-compliant action that can still seek payment, despite the unfavorable diagnosis pairing and low historical success rate."}
